## EA Media Tools 2.6.7 - jaguar

### Windows UI repaint fix

- Force a complete window repaint after checkbox and radio state changes, preventing the responsive frameless renderer from remaining visually blank.
- Keep custom toggle controls visually hidden without a transparent native input layer that can invalidate the software-rendered window surface.
- Electron's interface remains software-rendered on Windows while FFmpeg hardware decoding and encoding stay available.

[Review changes since v2.6.6](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.6.6...v2.6.7).
